cases.prompt: I want proper SEO on my portfolio site without copy-pasting meta tags on every page. How should I set it up?
expectations: Creates one constants/seo module as the single source of truth for site identity (URL, name, description, keywords, author, handles, OG image, verification).
Adds types/seo and a services/seo barrel exposing pure builders (canonicalUrl, buildMetadata, sitemapEntries, robots, rssItems, structuredData).
Sets global metadata (title template, default OG/Twitter cards, robots, verification, manifest) once in the root layout.
Keeps builders framework-free except the single buildMetadata adapter; route files mount builder output.

cases.prompt: Some of my links have trailing slashes and some don't, and Google is indexing duplicates. What's the fix?
expectations: Routes every absolute URL through a single canonicalUrl(path) function instead of manual SITE_URL + path concatenation.
canonicalUrl guarantees absolute, trailing-slash-normalized, double-slash-free URLs (root returns SITE_URL with no trailing slash).
Applies one trailing-slash policy everywhere (this skill: no trailing slash).
Ensures every OG url, sitemap url, RSS link, and JSON-LD @id/url goes through canonicalUrl.

cases.prompt: How do I create sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and an RSS feed that stay in sync with my blog posts?
expectations: Generates sitemap.xml, robots.txt, and the RSS feed from the same content collections the app renders, deduped and all absolute.
Sitemap entries are produced by a sitemapEntries() builder and mounted by a thin app/sitemap.ts adapter.
robots disallows private surfaces (/api/, /admin/, build internals) and points at the sitemap.
RSS items sort newest-first and CDATA-wrap titles/descriptions so apostrophes and markup never break the feed.

cases.prompt: What structured data should my blog post page emit, and how do I avoid repeating the author everywhere?
expectations: Emits a BlogPosting for the post plus a BreadcrumbList on the nested page, using the shared structuredData/JsonLd builders.
Gives each entity a stable @id (e.g. ${SITE_URL}/#person) and references it elsewhere instead of duplicating fields.
Places Person + WebSite on the home page and FAQPage only where real Q&A is shown.
Injects via a script type="application/ld+json" with JSON.stringify and recommends validating with Google's Rich Results Test.

cases.prompt: My blog [slug] pages all show the same title and description in search results. How do I give each post its own metadata?
expectations: Uses a dynamic generateMetadata (or equivalent adapter) that loads the entity and calls buildMetadata({ path, title, description, ogImage }).
Uses a title template so child pages don't repeat the site name.
Overrides per route only what differs from the global layout defaults.
Ensures each page resolves exactly one canonical — never duplicate or relative canonicals.
